docs.title: SubSentry
content: SubSentry was born out of the frustration of 'subscription fatigue.' I designed this system to aggregate, track, and optimize recurring digital expenses.
The architecture focuses on secure API integrations and a minimalist dashboard that highlights potential savings through automated usage analysis.
